item.title: Combiner 0.25.0
item.description:
• MIDI previews show their notes in the middle, no longer pushed to the right edge; clicking a note still plays from that note.
  • The hover card over a row no longer stays in front of other apps after you switch away.
  • The welcome card comes first: Combiner asks for Documents and Desktop only after you've answered it.
  • A damaged Ableton Live or FL Studio project no longer stops Combiner from starting, and older FL projects find their FL Studio samples.
  • A Logic project saved on the Desktop no longer shares your whole Desktop.
  • Downloads are sturdier: another member can't spoil or block yours, files stop being served once unshared, and leaving a room frees its download slot.
  • Render All no longer renames or trashes renders a project still plays, and no longer starts from a web link.
  • No more false "safe mode" after a quick quit.
